messages:
Avery (People Ops): Heads up @channel — the SF rooftop terrace will be closed for roof resealing Mon 2026-03-30 through Thu 2026-04-02. Were also moving the bike storage area for that week and running a temporary bike valet at the loading dock. Please read below for what this means and how to sign up.

Jules (Facilities): Quick logistics: roof crew on-site 7am-5pm. Terrace furniture will be covered and moved to the 3rd-floor lounge. Plants will be stored indoors. The loading dock valet runs 8am-6pm.

Chris L.: thanks! will the bike racks be accessible overnight or do we need to pick up daily?

Jules (Facilities): Racks will be inside the gated service area overnight — you can request overnight access if you need it, but the valet will be able to keep bikes secure. If you prefer to use your locker, were offering temporary locker rentals on the 2nd floor.

Priya Kapoor: is the terrace closure affecting the all-hands social on wed? (that was planned for the roof)

Avery (People Ops): Good catch — were moving the Wed social to the 2nd-floor east lounge (same capacity). Event invite updated.

Marisol: accessibility question — will the alternate social space be step-free? need to confirm for a guest.

Jules (Facilities): Yes, 2nd-floor east lounge is elevator accessible. If anyone has specific ADA needs, DM me and Ill coordinate.

Leo - Eng: any changes to dog-friendly day policy for next Fri since roof is closed?

Avery (People Ops): Dogs are still welcome on Friday; please use the 2nd-floor lounge instead of the roof. Keep pets leashed and current on vaccines per policy.

Priya Kapoor: how do i sign up for the bike valet?

Jules (Facilities): Sign-up form: https://forms.redwood.example/sf-bike-valet-2026 (or drop by the loading dock 8-10am). If you have a folding bike and need early pickup, mark "early pickup" on the form.

Facilities Bot: Calendar event created: "SF Roof Reseal & Bike Valet (Mar 30-Apr 2)" — invites sent to building-occupants@redwood.

Chris L.: will there be a place to lock helmets/gear?

Jules (Facilities): Well have a small gear table at the valet and 10 temporary helmet hooks by request. If you need a locker, use the form and pick a numbered locker.

Avery (People Ops): Expense note: bike valet is free. If you need bike maintenance due to construction (flat tire, damage), Facilities will reimburse up to $50 with a receipt — use expense code FAC-BIKE and tag People Ops for fast-track.

Marisol: :bicyclist: love the reimbursement, thanks. also +1 to moving the social inside.

Leo - Eng: thanks team — fyi ill bring extra floor mats to protect the lounge flooring during the social.

Jules (Facilities): FYI contractors will use the service entrance on 2nd Ave. Please avoid that door for safety between 7am-5pm.

Avery (People Ops): TL;DR: Roof closed Mar 30-Apr 2, rooftop social moved to 2nd-floor east lounge, free bike valet at loading dock 8-6, temporary lockers available, FAC-BIKE reimbursement up to $50. Form link above. DM People Ops or Jules with questions. Thanks!

Chris L.: noted.

Priya Kapoor: RSVPd done for the social.

Jules (Facilities): Will post signage by the terrace and elevators tomorrow morning.

Facilities Bot: Reminder scheduled: 1-day prior notice to all building occupants.
